<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/evaluators/variants/{evaluator_variant_id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Edit a variant's metadata.

Edits only touch variant-level metadata. To change evaluator
behavior commit a new revision via
`/evaluators/revisions/commit`.
